literature_notes: RELL2 is a single-pass Type II transmembrane protein: extracellular N-terminus spans residues 1–14, TM helix 15–35, and the entire C-terminal domain (36–303) is intracellular. All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe the same two constructs: (1) a C-terminal HA-tagged RELL2 made with pCMV-HA-C, whose tag lands at intracellular residue 303, and (2) a Flag-tagged RELL2 whose tag position is never stated in the ledger. Neither qualifies as an extracellular surface tag site. The short extracellular N-terminal span (residues 1–14, only 3 residues from the TM boundary at residue 15) has zero ledger support for any tag insertion. No site is proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal HA tag (pCMV-HA-C) on full-length RELL2; the C-terminus (residue 303) lies in the intracellular domain (topology residues 36–303), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the cell surface.
